name: status-verify
description: Status and verify behaviors: stack detection, component selection, installed-tree checks.

cases.name: stack-detect-dart
cases.description: A pubspec.yaml at the root signals the dart stack; sdk-dart is selected.

cases.name: stack-detect-rust-and-node
cases.description: Cargo.toml plus package.json (outside excluded dirs) selects both SDKs; updater ownership is ambiguous.

cases.name: stack-detect-webview-projection
cases.description: A package.json anywhere outside excluded dirs projects bindings-ts even without a node SDK consumer at the root. Languages follow registry order: sdk-rust's rust, then bindings-ts's node.

cases.name: host-scripts-tree-hash
cases.description: The tree hash is LF-normalized, sorted by path, excludes __pycache__, and hashes path+content pairs.
